## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`).
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests.
- [ ] New or changed interface text is extracted and translated in `en`, `fr` and `de`.
- [ ] If the API changed: `just openapi` was run and the regenerated files are committed.
- [ ] If the interface changed: screenshots on desktop and mobile are attached.
